doc.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24

chapter: Photographs of the Creole Fiesta and family
title: The tea, soiree and block dance cycle; patio and speakers
summary: The year's events and photographs of a tea with a speaker reciting in French and the patio before the freeze.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Yeah. Stay as long as you want now, when you get tired yourself. Now, this is the tea. You know, we have so many things to our... We have the tea, then the what?
We begin with the tea. Then you have the soiree in November?
Soiree, block dance, all of that.

And so we're always having something. Now, this is our tea. And we had...this lady was saying a speech for us. Now, this is my patio, the way it was with all...see all the leaves and everything? Now you can see what it looked like before the freeze. Now you can see what it looked like now.
This lady is in costume here.

Yes. And she's making a speech there. You can see the back of my husband. But now you can see all this was nothing but leave. That's out in my patio, you know. Now, this is that lady I told her. I want you to meet Miss Wing. Yeah, look at that. She's a French... Yes, she is. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.

She's saying...and she's reciting in French. That's right. She speaks French beautifully. Now, now look at me. You can see the coffee pie. I played it is there. And with my fat self, that's what I can see. I was fat. Yeah. I was saying something.
I think you liked being fat. Yeah. I didn't want... She miss it.
I didn't want to be small. I want to think...I didn't want to be too big. Mm-hmm .
